about: INVENTED test material for fuelInjectorClaims.test.js. Not taken from any manual or document: every title, filename, sentence and figure here was made up for the test. Do not paste real manual text into this file.

chunks.chunkText: Bench figures for the Zephyr test rig. Fuel injector assembly coil resistance 7.7 to 8.3 Ω at 25°C (77°F). Fuel pump motor coil resistance 1.4 to 2.6 Ω at 25°C (77°F). Fuel level sender track resistance 21.5 to 24.5 Ω with the float high.

Harness test for the Zephyr test rig. With the connector removed, the wire between pin 4 and the controller should read below 2 Ω. Between pin 4 and the chassis it should read 50 kΩ or higher. Reconnect the fuel injector assembly after the test.
